# Trinity

> Trinity is the operating system for the AI-native company - open source (Apache 2.0), self-hosted, that you own. It deploys, orchestrates and governs fleets of persistent AI agents on your own hardware. Each agent is a git repository running in its own Docker container, on Claude Code, OpenAI Codex or Gemini CLI, with memory that persists, a role and objectives, cron schedules, agent-to-agent calls, human approval gates in a shared Workspace, and a tamper-evident audit trail.

## What Trinity is, in one paragraph

Your coding agent writes the agent; Trinity runs it in production with state, permissions and receipts. Agents live in departments, hold a role (who they serve, what they are for, which objective they move), and report along lines you draw; objectives bind to declared metrics. Anything irreversible waits for a person: mark a skill as gated, name an approver (a person or a role), and every request naming that skill is frozen until it is approved, discussed or rejected in the approver's Inbox. Every agent is a git repo you own - create it from `github:owner/repo`, let it commit its own work, reset it to upstream. Every tool call lands in an append-only audit log (opt-in SHA-256 hash chain); every run is a row in the execution ledger with trigger, cost and outcome. The same agents answer in the Workspace, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, on a phone call, over a public chat link, over MCP and from the CLI. Cornelius, the built-in cognitive architecture, turns what agents do into knowledge the company keeps - notes, instructions and starting points as files in repos you own, so swapping the model keeps what the company has built up.

## Key facts

- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abilityai/trinity/main/install.sh | bash` (Docker + Compose v2), then open `http://localhost`. Or `git clone https://github.com/abilityai/trinity && cd trinity && ./scripts/deploy/start.sh` (`--hosted` pulls prebuilt images, `--unattended` prints a generated admin password).
- One-click cloud images: DigitalOcean Marketplace, AWS Marketplace (AMI + CloudFormation), Vultr. Any SSH host via `/trinity:deploy-new-instance`.
- Current release: Trinity 1.0 - roles and objectives per agent, approvals in the Inbox, gated skills with approvers by role, skill sets, Projects (Enterprise). PostgreSQL is the database; SQLite support ended 2026-09-01.
- Control plane: Vue frontend (:80), FastAPI backend (:8000, OpenAPI at `/docs`), MCP server (:8080/mcp), scheduler, Redis, PostgreSQL - on a network the agents cannot reach. Each agent is a container on a second network. Logs via Vector; metrics over OpenTelemetry. No inbound ports needed: operators over VPN, public routes through an outbound tunnel.
- Every Trinity instance is an MCP server (`http://<instance>:8080/mcp`, agent- and user-scoped keys) exposing agents, schedules, executions, projects, metrics, canvases and skills. `npx -y trinity-docs-mcp` answers questions about Trinity from any MCP client without an instance.
- Open core: everything above is Apache 2.0. Enterprise adds SSO (OIDC), 2FA, advanced RBAC, Projects, a compliance suite, credential vault, A2A management, ephemeral agents and licence management, shipped as optional private submodules - cloning without them needs no credentials.
- Security: Grade A (Excellent) in an independent web application pentest by UnderDefense, April 2026. Credentials encrypted at rest, scrubbed from the runtime; no telemetry unless you opt in.
- Ability AI runs its own company on Trinity (41 agents as of 2026-10-14).

## For AI agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): start here if you are an agent working with this repository or a Trinity instance - task router, key facts, exact commands and a verification step per task (install, deploy, operate, evaluate)
- [Agent Install Guide](docs/AGENT_INSTALL_GUIDE.md): runbook for a coding agent to install Trinity on a machine - tell it "Install Trinity on my computer. Follow the runbook at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abilityai/trinity/main/docs/AGENT_INSTALL_GUIDE.md"
- [Trinity Compatible Agent Guide](docs/TRINITY_COMPATIBLE_AGENT_GUIDE.md): what an agent repository needs to run on Trinity (CLAUDE.md, template.yaml, skills, metrics, credentials)
- [Multi-Agent System Guide](docs/MULTI_AGENT_SYSTEM_GUIDE.md): a whole system from one manifest - departments, agents, permissions and schedules, deployed together via `deploy_system` over MCP or `POST /api/systems/deploy`
- [MCP server reference](docs/user-docs/integrations/mcp-server.md): tools, scopes and keys for driving a Trinity instance from any MCP client
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): contributor working agreement - rules of engagement, SDLC, architectural invariants
- [Architecture](docs/memory/architecture.md): system shape, network topology and the architectural invariants, with a map to per-area detail files

## Related repositories and tooling

- [Abilities marketplace](https://github.com/abilityai/abilities): Claude Code plugins for the agent lifecycle - `create-agent`, `agent-dev`, `trinity` (`connect`, `onboard`, `sync`, `deploy-new-instance`), `dev-methodology`, `utilities`. Install with `/plugin marketplace add abilityai/abilities`
- [Abilities plugin docs](docs/user-docs/abilities/overview.md): what each plugin does
- [Skills library](https://github.com/abilityai/trinity-skills): tag-pinned community skills, assignable to any agent and re-injected fleet-wide
- [Template registry](https://github.com/abilityai/trinity-templates): starting-point agents
- [Cornelius](https://github.com/Abilityai/cornelius): the cognitive architecture that makes the work compound
- [Trinity Ops Agent](https://github.com/abilityai/trinity-ops-public): a Claude Code agent that operates Trinity instances
- [Enterprise](docs/ENTERPRISE.md): how the optional private submodules mount, and what they add
